content_sections.heading: About ESIC Asansol
content_sections.text: ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Asansol is at Sen Raliegh Road, Vivekanand Sarani, Asansol - 713305 (W.B.). The notice is issued by the Dean (I/C) under the Employees' State Insurance Corporation. It invites eligible candidates for vacant teaching faculty posts (Professor, Associate Professor and Assistant Professor) and for Senior and Junior Resident positions on a contractual basis.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice lists 24 departments, with each post's count and category break-up. Vacancies add up to 12 Professor, 19 Associate Professor, 25 Assistant Professor and 52 Senior Resident posts. A further 2 Junior Resident posts (1 OBC, 1 UR) are printed separately, making 110 in all. The notice calls the vacancies provisional: they may increase or decrease as per actual requirement for teaching and patient care. Junior Resident: total 2 posts (1 OBC, 1 UR). The notice prints no department-wise break-up for these two posts.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The cut-off date for age, qualifications and other eligibility criteria is 01 December 2026. Retired faculties may also apply for eligible posts. All medical candidates must hold updated Medical Registration (NMC/State Medical Council) with all post-MBBS/MD/MS qualifications. Candidates without updated registration must produce proof of having applied for it at the time of interview, and selected candidates must submit the updated registration certificate before joining. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, refer to the official notification. Age relaxation is as per the prevailing norms of the Government of India. The maximum tenure of engagement for teaching faculty is till 70 years of age, whichever is earlier, provided other rules and regulations are satisfied.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The pay is as per ESIC Headquarters Office Memorandum No. Z-11012/51/2022-MED-VI dated 08.12.2022 or any subsequent orders. Non-medical officers, if selected, are not entitled to Non-Practicing Allowance (NPA). Faculty: initial tenure 1 year, extendable by up to 2 years on satisfactory performance, willingness, conduct and institutional requirement, subject to a maximum tenure of 3 years. The post may be terminated on the joining of a regular incumbent as per ESIC Hqrs. Guidelines as may be applicable, or on attainment of 70 years of age, whichever is earlier. Senior Resident: initial tenure 1 year, extendable by up to 2 years on satisfactory performance etc, maximum 3 years. The post may be terminated on the joining of Bond SR as per ESIC Hqrs. Guidelines as may be applicable, or on attainment of 50 years of age, whichever is earlier. Junior Resident: initial tenure 1 year, extendable by up to 2 years on satisfactory performance etc, maximum 3 years. The post may be terminated on the joining of regular GDMO/Bond JR designated as Tutor/Bond JR designated as Demonstrator, and as per ESIC Hqrs. Guidelines as may be applicable. The Competent Authority may terminate services at any time in public interest without prior notice or reason. Resignation requires one month's advance notice or one month's salary; non-compliance may lead to forfeiture of salary and security deposit and possible legal action. No claim to PF, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Allowance/Benefits, Seniority, Promotion or similar benefits. Hostel/quarters may be provided subject to availability (not a right). If availed, HRA will not be paid, and license fee and other dues will be deducted. All instructions, circulars and policies of ESIC Headquarters, New Delhi, are binding. Absence exceeding 7 days without prior approval is treated as voluntary abandonment, leading to automatic termination, forfeiture of one month's salary and security deposit, and possible legal proceedings. Daily attendance (manual plus Aadhaar Enabled Biometric Attendance System) is mandatory. Other terms are as issued by the Competent Authority from time to time. A security deposit of ₹20,000 applies to each post: Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Senior Resident and Junior Resident. It is payable by Demand Draft in favour of "ESI FUND A/C NO. 1" payable at Asansol at the time of joining. It is refundable on successful completion of the contract and submission of a No Dues Certificate. It is forfeited if the candidate resigns within six (06) months of joining, except in unforeseen or unavoidable circumstances where relaxation may be considered.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in ESIC Asansol Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notice lists 110 posts: 12 Professor, 19 Associate Professor, 25 Assistant Professor, 52 Senior Resident and 2 Junior Resident. The notice calls the vacancies provisional.

faq.question: Q2. When are the ESIC Asansol walk-in interviews?
faq.answer: Interviews are on 01, 02 and 04 December 2026 for teaching faculty and Senior Residents, by department, and on 03 December 2026 for Junior Residents. Reporting time is 9:30 AM to 10:30 AM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for ESIC Asansol faculty and Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Qualification is as per the latest NMC/MCI guidelines applicable to the respective Broad Specialties. Academic eligibility shall be as per NMC-TEQ 2025 as amended from time to time.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for ESIC Asansol posts?
faq.answer: As on 01.12.2026, faculties must not exceed 67 years. Senior Residents must not exceed 50 years (Pre/para) or 45 years (Clinical). Junior Resident age is as per Govt. of India guidelines, with relaxation per prevailing norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for ESIC Asansol posts?
faq.answer: Total consolidated pay (approx.) is ₹2,66,732 for Professor, ₹1,72,816 for Associate Professor, ₹1,49,284 for Assistant Professor and Senior Resident, and ₹1,24,692 for Junior Resident.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for ESIC Asansol Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is nil for SC/ST/Female/Defence/Ex-servicemen/PH candidates and ₹500 for all other categories, by Demand Draft in favour of "ESI Fund A/c No.1" payable at Asansol. It is non-refundable.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for ESIC Asansol Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Bring the completed offline application form attached with the advertisement, with self-attested copies of documents and originals, to ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Asansol on your interview date. Use a separate form for each post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Candidates first go through document verification, and only verified candidates reach the Interview Board. Selection is on academic credentials and interview performance, and the result appears on www.esic.gov.in.

faq.question: Q9. Is the ESIC Asansol job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the posts are contractual. The initial tenure is 1 year, extendable by up to 2 years, with a maximum of 3 years. There is no claim to PF, Pension or Gratuity.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for more than one post at ESIC Asansol?
faq.answer: Yes, if eligible. A separate application, documents and fee (if applicable) are needed for each post.
